text:
deploy-bot: Rollout v2026.05.01-rc4 -> production (canary 10% eu-central). Post-deploy synthetic smoke started: https://deploys.redwood.internal/3523456789

nina: telemetry-bot flagged an uptick in short-generate probes returning HTTP 204 (probe id gen-smoke-lite). 7/50 failures, p95 unchanged.

marco: quick check: this build flipped the streaming guard that allows early-kv short-circuit. Could be returning empty when kv prefill is nil.

telemetry-bot: Alert: smoke.synthetic_empty_body{region="eu-central",route="/generate"} breached threshold at 2026-05-01T09:10:22Z. window volume 50.

nina: mitigation options: full rollback, region pin to stable, or small hotpatch to add explicit fallback. Prefer regional pin to limit blast radius.

ops-oncall: agree with regional pin. Execute and raise sampling to 200/10m. Also notify customers if we see production errors.

infra-bot: Executing: `pin-route --region eu-central --route /generate --target v2026.04.30-stable --reason "post-deploy synth empty responses on early-kv path"` — applied. Traffic validated.

marco: creating ticket RD-4999 and adding runtime/kv teams. Will repro in staging with injected cache-miss.

nina: updating release notes: "eu-central generate-route temporarily pinned to v2026.04.30-stable after synthetic probes detected empty responses on early-kv short-circuit; rollout paused for eu-central."

telemetry-bot: boosted sampling results: 200 probes -> 28 empties (14%) prior to pin. Post-pin baseline will be reported in 10m.

ops-oncall: change window: hold global ramp until 10:30 UTC or until RD-4999 triage completes (owner: marco).

nina: thread open until triage closed. Thanks team.

marco: (will post repro artifacts and logs by 09:20 UTC)

ops-oncall: nice catch by smoke harness :thumbsup:
